# Flatbread

> Flatbread turns an agent session into one link: what was asked, every step, what broke, what fixed it and the diff. People read it. Agents pull it and pick up where it ended.

A run page (https://flatbread.io/r/<id>) shows one agent session: the prompts, each step and tool call, the
failures and how the agent recovered, and the files it changed. Everything on it is read from the
session as recorded, with secrets replaced before upload.

Install with `npm install -g flatbread-cli` (the package is `flatbread-cli`; the npm package `flatbread` is
unrelated). Flatbread reads sessions from Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Google Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Cline and GitHub Copilot CLI, and `flatbread setup` connects Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Google Antigravity, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot CLI and Cline.

## For agents

- [Install and set up Flatbread](https://flatbread.io/install.md): steps an agent can follow
- [Docs](https://flatbread.io/docs): install, share, pull, what is redacted, and the CLI reference
- [How it works](https://flatbread.io/about): the three steps - share, read, pull - and the questions people ask first
- The execution brief of one run, as markdown: https://flatbread.io/api/runs/<id>/capsule

## Guides

- [How to share a Claude Code session](https://flatbread.io/guides/share-claude-code-session): What Claude Code's /export and /share do, where it saves each session, and how to share one as a link with every step, the diff and secrets removed.
- [How to share a Codex session](https://flatbread.io/guides/share-codex-session): What Codex's /export, /copy and /feedback do, where it saves each session, and how to share one as a link with every step, the diff and secrets removed.
- [Where agents keep their session logs](https://flatbread.io/guides/agent-session-logs): Where Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI and four more agents write each session on your disk, in what form, and what each one records.
